clips.title: The story
paras: On Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle keeps a network of buzzboxes working from Auberdine. The eccentric gnome engineer lives upstairs at the inn, far from the halls of Gnomeregan and Ironforge.

Wizbang Cranktoggle brings Alliance ingenuity to Auberdine. The gnome engineer works on the inn’s upper floor, among tools and spare parts. The night elves here seek harmony with nature and follow ancient customs. Wizbang turns instead to practical mechanical problems, far from the solemn druidic traditions of Kalimdor.

Along Darkshore’s rugged coast, Wizbang maintains a network of buzzboxes. His devices send automated reports and carry messages over long distances. Coastal weather and hostile wildlife often damage them. Wizbang asks travelers to find parts, salvage tools such as gaffer jacks, and recover electropellers so the network can keep working.
